title: Extracted code segment
statement: Given a nondeterministic Turing machine $N$ with Boolean input alphabet, natural-number parameters $d$ and $c$, a Boolean list $y$, and a natural number $\mathrm{off}$, let $y_1$ and $y_2$ be the first and second components obtained by decoding $y$. The extracted segment is the portion of $y_2$ after its first $\mathrm{off}$ entries, truncated to the verification code length for input length equal to the length of $y_1$.
hypotheses_covered: A nondeterministic Turing machine $N$ with Boolean input alphabet
